title: Inventory POS
shortDescription: Enterprise POS and Inventory Control Software | Complete Desktop Solution for Retail Business.
description:
⚡ ONE-TIME PAYMENT. LIFETIME ACCESS. UNLIMITED STORES.

Stop paying recurring monthly SaaS fees. Pay ONCE ($100) and own your Enterprise POS System forever!

Are you a store owner, retailer, or business manager looking for a fast, reliable, and secure Desktop POS system?

Enterprise POS & Inventory Control Center is a complete, production-ready desktop solution built with high-performance C++ and PostgreSQL. It runs 100% offline with ZERO monthly subscriptions, zero hidden costs, and zero cloud dependencies!

--- 

🎯 WHY THIS IS A NO-BRAINER INVESTMENT ($1,000+ VALUE)

* NO Monthly Subscription Fees: Pay once for $100 and use it forever.
* Unlimited Device Installations: Install on as many store terminals and PCs as you need without buying additional license keys.
* 100% Offline & Internet-Independent: Built on a secure local PostgreSQL engine. Your business and sales data stays completely on your device.
* Instant Digital Delivery: Get the ready-to-run installer (.exe) instantly upon purchase and set up your store in under 5 minutes!
* Direct Support Included: Have questions or setup issues? Get direct technical assistance from our core support team (msrk.support@gmail.com).

--- 

🚀 CORE ENTERPRISE MODULES & FEATURES

🔑 1. Multi-User & Role-Based Security
* Admin, Cashier, and Clerk account types with restricted access policies.
* Database Encryption: Passwords hashed securely using PostgreSQL pgcrypto.

📊 2. Executive Business Dashboard
* Instant operational snapshots of Daily Sales, Total Revenue, Active Items, and Low-Stock Warnings.

📦 3. Inventory & Category Management
* Full product management (Add, Edit, Search, Stock Adjustments).
* Dedicated Stock-Entry Workflow and automated low-stock flags.

🛒 4. High-Speed POS Checkout Engine
* Built for high-volume counter operations. Dynamic line-item updates, quantity adjustments, and auto-calculated totals.

📄 5. Professional PDF Receipts & Reports
* Printable A4 Receipts & Invoices with print preview.
* Filter sales reports by Today, This Week, This Month, or This Year and export as PDF.

🌍 6. Multi-Currency Engine & Custom Branding
* Set custom Store/Business Name across receipts and reports.
* Add custom currencies (PKR, USD, EUR, GBP, AED, SAR, etc.) with custom symbols.

🌓 7. Sleek Dual Visual Themes
* Dark Mode & Light Mode: Toggle seamlessly between clean dark mode and bright UI mode.

--- 

📦 WHAT YOU GET INSTANTLY UPON PURCHASE

1. Ready-to-Install Executable Package (InventoryPOS_Setup.exe)
2. Step-by-Step User & Database Setup Guide (PDF Manual)
3. Dedicated Support Line (Email: msrk.support@gmail.com)

🔑 Default First Launch Credentials:
* Username: admin
* Password: admin123
(Note: You can change default credentials immediately after logging in).

--- 

💰 READY TO UPGRADE YOUR STORE POS TODAY?

Click "I want this!" to download your executable setup package instantly and step into hassle-free retail management!
